questionSnapshot.question: What was the first animated feature film produced by Walt Disney Studios?
answers: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Challenged whether any listed film predates Snow White; the complete official filmography gives later years for all three. Official-title length is unavoidable rather than an explanatory clue.

verification.context: What was the first animated feature film produced by Walt Disney Studios?

premise.reason: Studio explicitly identifies Snow White as its first fully animated feature, in 1937.

sources.locator: Intro identifies first fully animated feature in 1937; filmography lists Snow White 1937, Pinocchio/Fantasia 1940, Bambi 1942; Aladdin 1992 and other film release years.
Biography paragraphs: Chicago birth, McKinley school and evening art classes; Hollywood arrival/office; daughters Diane and Sharon.
